label: Messenger
terms_note: Page-scoped: POST /{PAGE_ID}/messages (or /me/messages) with a Page access token holding pages_messaging (App Review for public apps); recipient is a PSID — the user must message the Page first (or click a CTA / plugin), no cold outreach. messaging_type RESPONSE / UPDATE inside the 24-hour standard window ('businesses have up to 24 hours to respond … messages sent within the 24-hour window may contain promotional content'); outside it only MESSAGE_TAG with an approved tag — HUMAN_AGENT (7-day manual response, app-review permission); CONFIRMED_EVENT_UPDATE / POST_PURCHASE_UPDATE / ACCOUNT_UPDATE non-promotional and per the send-messages page returning error 100 from 27 April 2026. sender_action typing_on / typing_off / mark_seen; text, images, audio, video, files, GIFs, buttons, templates, quick replies. Rate limits referenced but not enumerated on the pages read. Caution (docs read 2026-09-24): 'Advanced Access is required to access conversations between your business and people who do not have a role on your messaging app, your Instagram Professional account, your Facebook Page, or your business' (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/messenger-platform/conversations) - Advanced Access for pages_messaging comes through Meta App Review.

sdks: Meta Graph API — plain HTTPS; Business SDKs (developers.facebook.com/docs/messenger-platform)

tools.name: list_inbound
tools.endpoint: Webhook `messages` field; backfill GET /{page-id}/conversations?platform=messenger and GET /{conversation-id}/messages

endpoints.notes: 7-day manual response window; permission via App Review; CONFIRMED_EVENT_UPDATE / POST_PURCHASE_UPDATE / ACCOUNT_UPDATE non-promotional only and (per the send-messages page) error 100 from 27 Apr 2026

endpoints.call: POST /me/messenger_profile` (persistent menu, ice breakers, get started)

reference.limits: - Rate limits are referenced ("Messenger Platform rate limits") without numbers on the pages read; 429 / error 4, 613 → back-off. - No business-initiated first contact, no group messaging; "use of tags outside of approved use cases may result in restrictions". Sponsored Messages / One-time Notifications are separate products.

fields.name: page_access_token
fields.help: Page access token requested by a person who can perform the MESSAGING (or MODERATE) task on the Page, with pages_messaging, pages_manage_metadata and pages_read_engagement (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/messenger-platform/conversations); sent as `Authorization: Bearer`.

config_fields.name: page_id
config_fields.help: Numeric id of the Facebook Page whose Messenger inbox is used; every call goes to /<page_id>/... Env: PLATFORM_MCP_MESSENGER_PAGE_ID.

me.note: GET /{page_id}?fields=id,name,link: the Page that sends and receives Messenger messages.

list_inbound.note: GET /{page_id}/conversations?platform=messenger with field expansion messages.limit(1){...}: one row per conversation carrying its most recent message (which may be the Page's own outbound message - compare from_id with the Page / account id). thread_id is the conversation id for get_thread; from_id is the PSID for send. 'Conversations that are within the Requests folder that have not been active for 30 days will not be returned'. `since`/`channel` are not sent; cursor paging, so `page` is ignored.

get_thread.note: GET /{conversation_id}/messages?fields=id,message,from,to,created_time (newest first). 'you can only get details about the 20 most recent messages in the conversation' (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/messenger-platform/conversations), so limit is capped at 20.

send.note: POST /{page_id}/messages {recipient: {id: PSID}, messaging_type: RESPONSE, message: {text}} answers {recipient_id, message_id}. `to` must be a Page-scoped ID (list_inbound from_id); 'the conversation must be initiated by that person' and RESPONSE messages 'must be sent during the standard messaging window' (24 hours after the person's last message). `subject`/`channel` are ignored.

mark_read.note: Sender action mark_seen: POST /{page_id}/messages {recipient: {id}, sender_action: mark_seen} answers {recipient_id}. Here `thread_id` must be the person's PSID (list_inbound from_id), NOT the conversation id; `message_id` is not used. 'Requests to display sender action should only include the sender_action parameter and the recipient object.'

not_offered.reply: The Send API addresses a person, not a conversation: 'Set the ID for a person receiving the message in the recipient object parameter' (PSID, user_ref or post/comment id - https://developers.facebook.com/docs/messenger-platform/send-messages); a conversation id cannot be a recipient. Use send with the PSID (list_inbound from_id).

evidence: host graph.facebook.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (DigiCert Inc)
probe: 5/5 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 401 too, so the host authenticates before routing
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 5/5 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
